newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Pernas sells stake in MNI.
newsitem.headline: Pernas sells stake in MNI.

text.p: Hotel and property firm Pernas International Holdings Bhd said on Wednesday it has sold by private placement, its 10.2 percent stake in insurer MNI Holdings Bhd for 364 million ringgit.
Pernas said in a statement that the 28 million shares were sold at 13.00 ringgit a share which were held by subsidiairy Pernas Securities Sdn Bhd.
The stake was part of Pernas' total shareholding of 10.5 percent in MNI. Pernas did not say who bought the 10.2 percent stake.
The statement said proceeds from the sale would be used to reduce company borrowings.
Around 0400 GMT, MNI stock was at 12.80 ringgit, unchanged. Pernas rose three cents to 2.68.
